class.name: FellowFaceAnimator
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: a face that speaks and blinks — its mouth's blend shapes from the voice it plays (analysed as it plays, ahead of the sound), its eyes blinking at random.
class.description: A child anywhere under the character: set [member mesh_path] to the face's [MeshInstance3D] (its mesh with blend shapes; ARKit's names by default, see [member blend_shapes]) and [member voice_path] to the player of its voice ([AudioStreamPlayer], [AudioStreamPlayer2D] or [AudioStreamPlayer3D]). While the player plays, the stream is analysed a little ahead of its position (its playback rendered offline once and shared by every face playing it: the level and five bands' energies every 10 ms) into the mouth's channels — [constant CHANNEL_JAW_OPEN] with an open vowel's high first formant, [constant CHANNEL_MOUTH_WIDE] with a front vowel's high second formant, [constant CHANNEL_MOUTH_ROUND] with a back vowel's low one, [constant CHANNEL_TEETH] with the hiss of s and f, [constant CHANNEL_MOUTH_CLOSED] as it falls silent — read [member anticipation] ahead of what is heard, eased ([member attack], [member release]) and set on the blend shapes. A timeline can drive it instead: [member voice_stream] read at [member voice_time] (an [AnimationPlayer]'s track setting it). The eyes blink between [member blink_interval_min] and [member blink_interval_max] seconds apart. Language-independent and without phonemes: a stylised mouth, not a speech recogniser's visemes. See [code]docs/decisions/0191-face-animation.md[/code].

method.name: blink
method.description: Blinks now (unless a blink is under way).

method.name: clear_analysis_cache
method.description: Forgets every voice's analysis (analysed again when played again). The cache keeps at most 256 voices.

method.name: get_channel
method.description: A channel's value now, 0 to 1 (as set on the blend shapes).

method.name: get_channels
method.description: Every channel's value now, by name.

method.name: reset_global_stats
method.description: Sets the counts of [method get_global_stats] to zero.

method.name: sample_voice
method.description: The mouth's channels the analysis gives at [param time] seconds into [param stream] (unsmoothed), with the level ([code]level_db[/code]) and the scores they came from ([code]open_score[/code], [code]wide_score[/code], [code]low_score[/code], [code]hiss_score[/code], in dB), [code]analysed_seconds[/code] and [code]analysis_usec[/code].

members.member: How far ahead of what is heard the mouth reads the voice, in seconds: a mouth moves before its sound.
The time constant of a channel rising, in seconds.

member.name: blend_shapes
member.default: { "blink_left": PackedStringArray("eyeBlinkLeft"), "blink_right": PackedStringArray("eyeBlinkRight"), "jaw_open": PackedStringArray("jawOpen"), "mouth_closed": PackedStringArray(), "mouth_round": PackedStringArray("mouthPucker", "mouthFunnel"), "mouth_wide": PackedStringArray("mouthStretchLeft", "mouthStretchRight"), "teeth": PackedStringArray("mouthRollLower") }

members.member: Which blend shapes each channel moves: a channel's name ([code]jaw_open[/code], [code]mouth_wide[/code], [code]mouth_round[/code], [code]mouth_closed[/code], [code]teeth[/code], [code]blink_left[/code], [code]blink_right[/code]) and a blend shape's name or a [PackedStringArray] of them. A blend shape moved by several channels gets their sum (at most 1). By default ARKit's: [code]jawOpen[/code]; [code]mouthStretchLeft[/code], [code]mouthStretchRight[/code]; [code]mouthPucker[/code], [code]mouthFunnel[/code]; none; [code]mouthRollLower[/code]; [code]eyeBlinkLeft[/code]; [code]eyeBlinkRight[/code].
A blink's length, in seconds: closing in a third of it, closed a sixth, opening in half.
The longest time between two blinks, in seconds.
The shortest time between two blinks, in seconds.
The eyes blink at random intervals.
The voice's level (a sine's peak dB for its mean square over 20 ms) at which the mouth starts to move.
The voice's level at which the mouth's channels reach their full value.
At most this much of a voice is analysed (a longer one is silent past it; a loop wraps when it was all analysed).
The face's [MeshInstance3D]: its blend shapes are set each frame (only those that changed).
The time constant of a channel falling, in seconds.
The seed of the blinks' intervals.

The player of the voice: [AudioStreamPlayer], [AudioStreamPlayer2D] or [AudioStreamPlayer3D]. Its stream is analysed as it plays, at its playback position (what is heard: the mix's position, the time since the mix and the output's latency; under Movie Maker the position).
With [member voice_time] 0 or more: the voice read at that time instead of a player's (a timeline drives the face).
Where in [member voice_stream] the mouth reads, in seconds (an animation track can set it); below 0: the player at [member voice_path] drives it.

constants.constant: The jaw open: with the voice's level, most for open vowels (a).
The mouth wide: front vowels (i, e).
The mouth round: back vowels (u, o).
The lips closed: 1 in silence (not mapped by default).
The lower lip under the teeth: the hiss of s, f, sh.
